pages.text: The $(d)Scraper$() is used to get $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/organic_matter)Organic Matter$(/l) from mobs.$(br2)To use it, simply right-click the mob. This damages the mob, which counts as an attack and will anger neutral entities.
Scrapers can be enchanted with $(9)Delicate Touch$(), which prevents damaging and angering entities.
